_description: Single source of truth for agent design and build. The dashboard reads/writes this. The build skill reads this. Reports are generated from this. No separate agent-spec.md needed.

step1.problem: 2-3 sentence problem statement — what pain this agent solves, for whom

users.primary: Main user group who will interact most frequently
users.secondary: Supporting user group with occasional use

step2.capabilities: Newline-separated list of what the agent can do

scenarios.agentShould: What the agent does in response

step2.handle: Topics the agent should answer confidently
step2.decline: Requests the agent should politely redirect
step2.refuse: Hard stops — agent must never do these

systems.name: Tool or integration name (e.g. SharePoint/OneDrive, Salesforce)
systems.purpose: What this tool does for the agent
systems.notes: Optional — auth method, scoping, config details, why this choice

topics.name: Topic name
topics.yaml: Optional — generated YAML content for this topic

knowledge.name: Source name or URL
knowledge.type: SharePoint | Uploaded files | Dataverse | Public websites | Graph connectors
knowledge.scope: Optional — what content to index, filters, space/site scoping

step4.architectureReason: Why this architecture fits the use case
step4.model: GPT-4o | GPT-4o mini | GPT-5 Auto (Preview) | o1 | o1 mini | o3-mini
triggers: Trigger types — e.g. Conversational (user message), Recurrence, Event
channels: Channel names — e.g. Microsoft Teams, Custom website

children.name: Child agent name (for multi-agent only)
children.routingRule: When to route to this specialist

instructions: Full agent instructions text (up to 8000 chars). Written by Prompt Engineer, reviewed by QA Challenger. This is what gets pasted into MCS.

now: Capabilities to build in the current sprint
later: Capabilities deferred to future iterations with reason

evals.question: Test question to ask the agent
evals.expected: What the response should contain or convey
evals.category: happy-path | edge-case | boundary-decline | boundary-refuse | error-recovery | multi-turn

evalResults.lastRun: ISO timestamp of last eval run

buildStatus.lastBuild: ISO timestamp of last build attempt
buildStatus.publishedAt: ISO timestamp of last successful publish

openQuestions.question: Unresolved question that needs customer/stakeholder input
openQuestions.impact: What this blocks or affects if unanswered
openQuestions.suggestedDefault: Optional — our best guess if the customer doesn't answer
openQuestions.answer: Leave empty if unanswered. Fill in when resolved.

notes._description: Flexible key-value store for anything discovered during research or build that doesn't fit above. Keys are freeform. Use this for customer-specific details, integration notes, discovered constraints, etc.
notes.example: Any string value — research findings, customer preferences, technical constraints
